WITH returned_items AS (
  SELECT wr.wr_item_sk, COUNT(*) AS return_count
  FROM web_returns AS wr

  FROM catalog_returns AS cr
  GROUP BY cr.cr_item_sk
  UNION ALL
  SELECT sr.sr_item_sk, COUNT(*) AS return_count
  FROM store_returns AS sr
  GROUP BY sr.sr_item_sk
), item_return_totals AS (
  SELECT returned_items.wr_item_sk AS item_sk, SUM(returned_items.return_count) AS return_count
  FROM returned_items
  GROUP BY returned_items.wr_item_sk
), most_returned AS (
  SELECT item_return_totals.item_sk

), promoted_items AS (

)

FROM most_returned
JOIN item_return_totals ON item_return_totals.item_sk = most_returned.item_sk
